description: Prior Approval for a single storey upward extension of the mixed terraced building at 598-608 Chiswick, to create two self-contained residential units.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun within 3 years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (00, 01, 98, 99, 100, 101, 102, 103, 105, 110, 207 Rev B, 300 Rev B, Daylight Assessment: Received 01/12/2023. 201 Rev C: Received 19/01/2024. 206 Rev E: Received 23/01/2024.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, a Car Parking Management Plan shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the approved details and shall be maintained for the lifetime of the development, unless the prior written approval of the local planning authority is obtained to secure any variation.

Condition : 4 - The development shall not be occupied until arrangements have been agreed in writing with the local planning authority and put in place to ensure that, with the exception of disabled persons, no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit within any controlled parking zone which may be in force in the area at any time.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the submitted details and prior to first occupation of the dwellings, full details (including manufacturer's specifications) of all cycle parking facilities for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, complying with the standards set out in the London Plan. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards and West London Cycle Parking Guidance in design and layout and be fully implemented  and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 6 - Prior to first occupation of the development, full details of electric vehicle parking provision (7.2kW output) shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The facilities shall conform with requirements stipulated within the London Plan and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.

Condition : 7 - The hereby approved dwellinghouses are to remain in use as dwellinghouses within the meaning of Class C3 of Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwellinghouse.
Condition : 8 - The hereby approved development shall not include a window in any wall or roof slope forming a side elevation of the building.
